glosses: lover (a sexual partner, especially one with whom someone is having an affair)

examples.text: La vieron en un restaurante con su amante.
examples.en: She was seen at a restaurant with her lover.

examples.text: Soy un amante de la belleza en todas sus formas.
examples.en: I'm a lover of beauty in all its forms.

examples.text: Los amantes se intercambiaron varias cartas.

examples.en: The lovers were walking arm in arm.
